warnings: Training source: completed POS ingredient consumption with CSV history on uncovered dates; stock source: live inventory snapshot.
Store operates daily, 1 PM–10 PM (Asia/Manila): SARIMA uses daily totals and seven-day seasonality, not hourly forecasts.
Product filters show store-wide ingredient demand, not predicted product sales.

SARIMA compares log1p and scaled raw usage, recent/full history, Philippine holidays and weekday effects. Selection targets period usage error within a 10% MAE guard and 3% MAPE/RMSE limits relative to the reference MAPE objective. Zeros remain in absolute errors; undefined percentage errors are null.

Daily intervals target 95% coverage with up to 12 calibration periods and five later test periods excluded from the earlier model selection. A positive-usage tail guard protects against spikes; fewer than 19 positive calibration samples use the observed maximum, not a validated 95% positive-demand quantile. Measured coverage is reported separately; daily bounds are not simultaneous weekly bounds.

Main training history: 2024-01-01 through available 2026 CSV dates before the forecast; positive CSV daily consumption takes priority; POS fills zero or absent CSV consumption and extends history. CSV quantities are synthetic; POS quantities are actual recorded usage.
